name: localclaude
description: Personal Claude Code toolkit: bootstrap config conventions (claude-setup), switch the backend between Anthropic / Ollama / local llama.cpp / local MLX (Apple Silicon) with auto-managed servers (claude-toggle-backend), discover & manage local models by use case (local-models), run the phase-based development process (phase-workflow), and get external Codex + Gemini reviews at its checkpoints (review-checkpoint).
